user.title: Add a location
user.description: Enter a name and choose a region. Then enter the exact station (transformer station) name as the notices write it, for example Zabukovica Papež.

data_description.name: The name of the location, for example Home.
data_description.region: The region feed to watch. Choose All regions if you are not sure.
data_description.station: Choose a name from the list, or type the exact station name as the notices write it, without TP. The match ignores case, accents and spacing only. A part of the name does not match. The list shows the station names that are in the feeds now.

reconfigure.title: Change the location
reconfigure.description: Change the name, the region or the station. If you change the region or the station, the stored alert history is cleared.

data_description.name: The name of the location, for example Home.

data_description.station: Choose a name from the list, or type the exact station name as the notices write it, without TP. The match ignores case, accents and spacing only. A part of the name does not match. The list shows the station names that are in the feeds now.

confirm.title: Check the location

abort.invalid_import: The imported location is not valid.

deprecated_yaml.title: The Elektro Celje YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: Home Assistant imported your Elektro Celje binary sensors from YAML into config entries. Remove the `elektro_celje` platform entries from your YAML files, then restart Home Assistant. The imported locations keep working. Entity IDs of the new entities can differ from the old entity IDs.
